phrases.text: This is this week's Fortnite Item Shop! Every big bundle, every new drop, and every OG that came back.
Six days of the shop, from October 28th to November 2nd, straight from Epic's own Item Shop data.
Let's get into it!
First, the biggest bundle of the whole week.
The Five Nights at Freddy's Bundle!
Freddy Fazbear, Foxy, Chica, Bonnie, and more. Eighteen items in total.
Listed at 11,000 V-Bucks, it sold for 4,500.
It was in the shop until October 31st, so if you missed it, it's gone for now.
Now, the new stuff. These all went live this week.
The Adventure Time Bundle landed today, November 2nd!
Finn the Human, Jake the Dog, Princess Bubblegum, Marceline, and more. Thirteen items.
It's 3,800 V-Bucks, listed at 10,300, and it's in the shop until November 6th.
Right next to it, the Ice King and Lemongrab Bundle. 3,200 V-Bucks, listed at 5,400.
On November 1st, the One Piece Bundle dropped.
Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp, fifteen items, for 4,000 V-Bucks, listed at 8,200.
And this one sticks around. It's in the shop until December 3rd!
Same day, the Mariah Carey Bundle arrived. 2,800 V-Bucks, listed at 4,300, until November 4th.
And today, Harley Quinn is back too, with her own bundle for 2,000 V-Bucks.
Also new today, the Catwoman Zero Bundle, 1,500 V-Bucks, listed at 2,000.
That's not all. A bunch more bundles showed up during the week.
On October 29th, the HIT SQUAD Bundle, with Siren and Wolf, for 2,400 V-Bucks, listed at 3,700.
On October 30th, the Art the Clown Bundle, for 2,200.
Same day, the Knightmare Bundle for 2,000, and the Focal Point Bundle, with Focus, for 1,800.
And on October 31st, the Chaos Agent Bundle and the Xenomorph, Alien: Earth Bundle, both for 2,000 V-Bucks.
Halloween week brought the horror icons.
On October 28th, the A Nightmare on Elm Street Bundle came in, with Freddy Krueger, for 2,300 V-Bucks.
On October 31st, the Ripley and Xenomorph Bundle, for 2,200.
And the Predator: Badlands Bundle, with Dek, for 2,000 V-Bucks.
Plus two bundles with five outfits each, Grave The Day and Hero Horde, 3,500 V-Bucks each, listed at 7,500. Those were in the shop until October 30th.
If you're grabbing any of these, use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
A few big collaborations also left the shop this week.
The Shadow the Hedgehog and Knuckles the Echidna Bundle, 3,600 V-Bucks, was in the shop until October 31st.
The Yeat Bundle, also 3,600, left the same day.
And the Doja Cat Bundle, 3,200 V-Bucks, was in the shop until October 30th.
The Dr. Eggman Bundle, 2,000 V-Bucks, left on October 31st.
And today is the last day for the Beetlejuice Bundle. Nine items for 2,400 V-Bucks, listed at 5,300.
Now, the OGs!
Commando and Shadow Ops, both from Chapter 1, Season 1, were in the shop every single day this week.
Commando is 800 V-Bucks. Shadow Ops is 1,500.
Snowstrike, from Chapter 1, Season 7, was there all week too.
Rex, from Chapter 1, Season 3, showed up for three days.
And today, Fishstick, from Chapter 1, Season 7, is back in the shop.
A few more Chapter 1 outfits stopped by during the week.
On October 28th, Mayhem and Ruckus, both from Chapter 1, Season 6.
On October 30th, Highrise Assault Trooper from Season 2, and Astro Assassin and Focus from Season 9.
Moxie from Season X came in on October 30th, and Guaco, also from Season X, on November 1st.
And today, Hime from Season 5, Rosa from Season 6, and Aura, Buccaneer and Sea Wolf from Season 8.
Last, what's leaving soon.
The Ripley and Xenomorph Bundle is in the shop until November 3rd.
Mariah Carey and Predator: Badlands, until November 4th.
Rest in Peace and Chaos Agent, also until November 4th.
Inoxtag, until November 5th.
Adventure Time, Ice King and Lemongrab, Harley Quinn, and Catwoman Zero, until November 6th.
And One Piece, all the way to December 3rd.
Quick recap!
Biggest bundle of the week: Five Nights at Freddy's. Newest: Adventure Time. The one that stays the longest: One Piece.
And Commando and Shadow Ops never left.
Which bundle did you grab this week? Tell me in the comments!
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
